c.fail_witnesses: Every pass/True above was a genuinely discriminating check, not a vacuous one -- each had a concrete way to come out otherwise: (1) dim Z(C0) was checked against ALL 128 even blades, not a generating subset; had any intermediate-degree blade (e.g. a degree-4 blade) also commuted with everything, it would have shown up in 'basis blades S (even) commuting with ALL 128 even blades' and dim Z(C0) would have printed >2 -- it printed exactly [(), (0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7)]. (2) omega^2 was computed by two independent routes that could have disagreed (a bug in either) or could have returned -1 or a non-square rational (had the diagonal come out with an ODD count of minus signs, i.e. had N NOT been maximally split/Witt-index-4, the SAME closed-form (-1)^(m(m-1)/2).prod(d_i) would have produced a different sign and Z(C0) would have been a quadratic FIELD, not Q x Q) -- both routes gave exactly +1 on the actual computed diagonal (1,1,1,1,-1,-1,-1,-1), which has an EVEN count of minus signs (4), the genuine reason the split answer occurs. (3) The C0=M8(Q)xM8(Q) isomorphism check could have returned rank <128 (a real failure mode for either a true non-isomorphism or an implementation bug in the 16x16 representation) -- it returned exactly 128/128, det=2^256≠0. (4) The two independently-written code paths (blade-rewrite engine vs. Fock-space matrix rep) could have disagreed on any of the 64 exhaustively-checked generator relations or the 400 randomly-sampled blade products -- 0 disagreements. (5) The exhaustive 128^3=2,097,152-triple associativity sweep on C0 could have found a bug -- 0 failures. None of these five independent falsification opportunities fired.

v.item: THE CLIFFORD COMPUTATION — C(A,σ)/C0(N) of B904's split-octonion norm form N(x)=ab−u·v (adversarial independent rebuild, lens: own basis/own diagonalization, idempotent exactness, discriminant-sign attack, MB12 bite test)
v.finding:
Everything survives. Full independent rebuild in (scratchpad) (stage_a..e*.py + outputs), touching only frontier/B904_barton_sudbery/stage1_construct.py (Read-only) plus WORKING_RULES.md and a read-only grep of NOVELTY_SWEEP_LEDGER.md for context; repo confirmed unmodified (git status/diff clean); no pencil-triple file read anywhere; all load-bearing arithmetic exact (sympy Rational / Python Fraction) — the ONE floating-point use (numpy eigenvalues of G) is explicitly flagged as a non-load-bearing signature cross-check only.

STAGE A — basis-free discriminant (own route, not relying on any diagonalization): det(G)=1/256=(1/16)^2 exactly, an exact perfect rational square, via two independent computations (sympy .det() on the full symbolic 8x8, and the product of the four manifest 2x2 hyperbolic-block determinants: (-1/4)^4=1/256). Since det(G)=det(Phi)^2*prod(D) for ANY diagonalizing Phi, and det(Phi)^2 is automatically square, det(G) being an exact square pins the discriminant square-class to trivial regardless of which diagonalization is used — this alone already rules out the 'wrong sign flips it to a field' failure mode independent of basis choice.

STAGE B — three independent diagonalizations: (1) a from-scratch generic symmetric congruence-reduction algorithm (handles zero pivots via hyperbolic pairing, NOT hand-tailored to the (0,7)/(1,4)/(2,5)/(3,6) block structure) — normalized diagonal (1,-1,-1,1,-1,1,-1,1); (2) numpy eigenvalues of G, a completely different numerical method — eigenvalues exactly ±0.5 (4 and 4), confirming signature (4,4); (3) an independently-inverted, differently-scaled hand construction — diagonal (1/4,-1/4,-1/4,1/4,-1/4,1/4,-1/4,1/4), product 1/65536=(1/256)^2, again a positive perfect square. All three agree with each other and with the deliverable's stated (1,1,1,1,-1,-1,-1,-1).

STAGE C — own from-scratch Clifford blade-multiplication engine (bubble-sort-with-contraction on index lists), unit-tested on hand cases including a quaternion sanity check ((e0e1)^2=-1 when e0^2=e1^2=-1). Run on THREE different diagonal orderings (own Route-1 order, the deliverable's stated order, and an arbitrary reshuffle of the same multiset): (a) EXHAUSTIVE associativity on all 128^3=2,097,152 even-blade triples, 0 failures, every time; (b) center computed TWO independent ways (commuting with all 128 even blades vs. commuting with only the 28 weight-2 generators — mathematically sufficient by the generation argument) — agree exactly every time, dim Z(C0)=2, spanned by {1, omega}; (c) omega^2=1 via brute-force table lookup, matching a closed-form formula (-1)^{n(n-1)/2}*prod(d_i) that I derived from scratch by an induction/anticommutation-counting argument and validated by hand on the n=2 toy case ((e1e2)^2=-1 for e1^2=e2^2=1) before trusting it here; (d) idempotents eps+=(1+omega)/2, eps-=(1-omega)/2 checked EXACTLY: eps+^2=eps+, eps-^2=eps-, eps+*eps-=eps-*eps+=0, eps+ +eps-=1, AND both are exactly central against ALL 128 even blades (not just generators) — all confirmed on every one of the three diagonal orderings; (e) independently re-confirmed the structure-constant claim: the set of nonzero values across all 128x128=16384 products is exactly {+1,-1}.

STAGE D — MB12 bite test (the required 'exhibit a non-split control with a genuine field center'): ran the UNMODIFIED pipeline on two independent minimal one-entry perturbations of the real diagonal. Control 1, (1,1,1,1,-1,-1,-1,-2): predicted by hand prod(d)=2, omega^2=2, confirmed by brute force, T^2-2 irreducible over Q (sympy) => Z(C0)=Q(sqrt2), a genuine real quadratic field. Control 2, (1,1,1,1,-1,-1,-1,+1) (breaks the sign-count parity instead of the magnitude): predicted omega^2=-1, confirmed, T^2+1 irreducible => Z(C0)=Q(i), a genuine imaginary quadratic field. Both controls correctly reported as fields, NOT Q x Q, run in the same process alongside a re-run of the real split diagonal (still correctly Q x Q) — the pipeline demonstrably discriminates, it is not vacuously always returning split.

STAGE E — independent verification of the STRONGER claim C0≅M8(Q)xM8(Q) (center alone doesn't rule out e.g. M4(D) for a quaternion division algebra D with the same center), via a SECOND, differently-constructed representation: Jordan-Wigner creation/annihilation operators built directly on the ORIGINAL isotropic x-generators (x_i^2=0, not via my orthogonal f-basis at all). CAR relations verified exactly (48 checks), the Clifford defining relations {X_i,X_j}=2G_ij*I verified exactly on all 64 generator pairs, all 128 even-blade images confirmed exactly block-diagonal w.r.t. the even/odd Fock-occupation split, and the stacked 128x128 block matrix has EXACT full rank 128 with det=1 (nonzero) — an independent confirmation of the isomorphism via a different determinant value (1, vs. the deliverable's 2^256) but the same qualitative full-rank/nonzero-det conclusion, which is all the isomorphism claim requires. One self-caught-and-resolved snag, reported for transparency: my first attempt at an extra cross-check compared 'omega' built by multiplying the ORIGINAL isotropic generators against 'omega' built by multiplying the orthogonal f-generators (Stage C) — these are DIFFERENT algebra elements (confirmed by hand on a 1-mode Fock toy: B-dagger*B-annihilation is idempotent, not order-2), not a bug in the Clifford construction itself. Diagnosed exactly (the raw unnormalized product's square predicted at prod(D1_raw)=1/256=det(G), confirmed to the digit), then fixed by pushing Stage C's actual omega through Stage E's representation via the correct NORMALIZED change of basis — after the fix, rho(omega_C)^2=I16 exactly, and rho(eps_C+)/rho(eps_C-) land EXACTLY on the tautological even/odd block projectors, closing the loop between the two independently-built constructions with full agreement.

Net: the discriminant-sign attack found nothing wrong — every independent route (basis-free determinant, three diagonalizations, own blade engine, own matrix representation) agrees the square class is trivial and omega^2=1 exactly; the idempotents are exactly central and orthogonal by direct computation, confirmed twice via two unrelated constructions; the MB12 bite test shows the computation is genuinely discriminating, not vacuous; and the stronger M8(Q)xM8(Q) claim (not just the center) is independently reconfirmed via a second, differently-built representation. The only irregularity found was in my own extra-credit cross-check, fully diagnosed as a basis/normalization mismatch (not a defect in the target computation) and resolved with exact agreement.
